title: Three Stones North  (Tres losas hacia el norte)

segments.t: El amanecer del sábado despunta suavemente sobre el Patio de los Tilos. Mientras los huéspedes del piso superior aún duermen, Hannah, Graham y Arthur salen de puntillas al patio silencioso llevando un farol de latón y una barra plana de hierro. Escucha la escena completa.
Whisper, both of you — it is only half past six on Saturday morning!
Help me lift table number one aside gently so the legs do not scrape.
Read the postcard clue one more time before I touch the stones, Hannah.
The retired mapmaker wrote: Count three flat stones north from the old shade tree.
Which way is north in my own courtyard? Where did my glasses go?
Your glasses are sitting above your eyebrows, Arthur, and north faces the front gate.
Stone one, stone two, and here is stone three with the loose mortar edge.
Tap the middle with your wooden handle, Graham — does it really sound hollow?
Listen to that clear echo underneath: there is a small space below this stone.
Nobody has lifted this flagstone since that rainy May thirty summers ago!
Please be careful, Graham, because replacement courtyard stones cost a small fortune!
Stand back half a step while I slide the flat bar under the corner.
Ahora analicemos paso a paso esta conversación al amanecer en el patio.
Whisper, both of you — it is only half past six on Saturday morning!
'¡Susurren los dos: apenas son las seis y media de la mañana del sábado!'
Help me lift table number one aside gently so the legs do not scrape.
'Ayúdenme a levantar con cuidado la mesa número uno hacia un lado para que las patas no raspen el suelo.'
Read the postcard clue one more time before I touch the stones, Hannah.
'Lee la pista de la tarjeta postal una vez más antes de que yo toque las piedras, Hannah.'
The retired mapmaker wrote: Count three flat stones north from the old shade tree.
'El cartógrafo jubilado escribió: «Cuenten tres piedras planas hacia el norte desde el viejo árbol de sombra».'
Which way is north in my own courtyard? Where did my glasses go?
'¿Hacia dónde queda el norte en mi propio patio? ¿Adónde fueron a parar mis gafas?'
Your glasses are sitting above your eyebrows, Arthur, and north faces the front gate.
'Tus gafas están puestas encima de tus cejas, Arthur, y el norte mira hacia el portón de entrada.'
Stone one, stone two, and here is stone three with the loose mortar edge.
'Primera piedra, segunda piedra, y aquí está la tercera piedra con el borde de argamasa suelto.'
Tap the middle with your wooden handle, Graham — does it really sound hollow?
'Golpea suavemente el centro con tu mango de madera, Graham: ¿de verdad suena hueco?'
Listen to that clear echo underneath: there is a small space below this stone.
'Escuchen ese eco tan claro debajo: hay un pequeño hueco bajo esta piedra.'
Nobody has lifted this flagstone since that rainy May thirty summers ago!
'¡Nadie ha levantado esta losa desde aquel mayo lluvioso de hace treinta veranos!'
Please be careful, Graham, because replacement courtyard stones cost a small fortune!
'¡Por favor ten cuidado, Graham, porque las losas de repuesto para el patio cuestan una pequeña fortuna!'
Stand back half a step while I slide the flat bar under the corner.
'Retrocedan medio paso mientras deslizo la barra plana bajo la esquina.'
Escuchemos toda la escena una vez más a velocidad natural.
Whisper, both of you — it is only half past six on Saturday morning!
Help me lift table number one aside gently so the legs do not scrape.
Read the postcard clue one more time before I touch the stones, Hannah.
The retired mapmaker wrote: Count three flat stones north from the old shade tree.
Which way is north in my own courtyard? Where did my glasses go?
Your glasses are sitting above your eyebrows, Arthur, and north faces the front gate.
Stone one, stone two, and here is stone three with the loose mortar edge.
Tap the middle with your wooden handle, Graham — does it really sound hollow?
Listen to that clear echo underneath: there is a small space below this stone.
Nobody has lifted this flagstone since that rainy May thirty summers ago!
Please be careful, Graham, because replacement courtyard stones cost a small fortune!
Stand back half a step while I slide the flat bar under the corner.
Tres losas planas al norte del viejo árbol, la piedra hueca está lista para levantarse por primera vez en treinta años tranquilos. ¡Nos vemos en la siguiente escena!
See you next time!
